definitions.gloss: to pile up, to be stacked
definitions.explanation: For things to be placed one on top of another.
For things to occur at the same time or place.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}が{重|かさ}なっている。
{予定|よてい}が{重|かさ}なった。

notes:
{重|かさ}なる is an intransitive godan verb meaning to pile up, overlap, or coincide.

TRANSITIVITY PAIR:
- {重|かさ}なる ({自動詞|じどうし}): to pile up (intransitive)
- {重|かさ}ねる ({他動詞|たどうし}): to stack (transitive)

PHYSICAL STACKING:
- {本|ほん}が{重|かさ}なる: books pile up
- {雪|ゆき}が{重|かさ}なる: snow accumulates
- {皿|さら}が{重|かさ}なる: plates are stacked

OVERLAPPING/COINCIDING:
- {予定|よてい}が{重|かさ}なる: schedules overlap
- {不幸|ふこう}が{重|かさ}なる: misfortunes pile up
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}が{重|かさ}なる: coincidences multiply

ACCUMULATION:
- {努力|どりょく}が{重|かさ}なる: efforts accumulate
- {経験|けいけん}が{重|かさ}なる: experience builds up
- {年月|としつき}が{重|かさ}なる: years pass/accumulate
